name: Electoral Boundaries
description:
Who represents you in Stratford, PEI, at every level of government. The Municipal tab shows the three municipal wards, Ward 1 (Kelly's Cove), Ward 2 (Stewart Cove) and Ward 3 (Tea Hill), and the five polls in each. The Provincial tab shows Stratford's two provincial districts, Mermaid-Stratford and Stratford-Keppoch, and their polls. All of Stratford is in one federal riding, Cardigan. Click anywhere in town to see who represents that spot.

To look up your ward, councillors, MLA and MP by address, try the [[https://www.stratfordmaps.ca/lookup|Address Lookup]].

[[https://www.electionspei.ca/sites/www.electionspei.ca/files/EPEI_StratMap2018.pdf|Stratford ward map (Elections PEI, PDF)]]
[[https://townofstratford.ca/government-services/contact-town-of-stratford/mayor-council/|Mayor and Council (Town of Stratford)]]
